# FLX-3508: a sink option is named like a credential

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A sink never takes a credential as an option: a command line is visible to every user of the machine and is kept in shell history, and a record of the run would carry it. An option whose name holds the word password, secret, token, credential, sas, signature, passphrase, authorization, bearer or a key (access-key, account-key, api-key, authkey, secretaccesskey and the like) is refused, however it is spelled (access-key, access_key, accesskey, AccessKey), before the sink is opened, for every sink, built-in or not. The message names the option and never its value. Credentials come from the environment or from the platform's own credential chain, so remove the option and set the variable the destination's library reads, or sign in the way the platform does. Nothing was written.
